descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S09 Picker with more than 40 patients: the 46th is still reachable and gets the text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given 45 Hospital patients in rooms 1–45 plus QA Hosp Zuniga in room 999 (last in room order)

When Type 'Seen and examined, stable, continue current plan.' into a box, open Assign to patient without searching, then search 'Zuniga' and pick him; open both charts

Then Zuniga is found through the search and his Encounter note ends with the box text; QA Hosp Bulk 001's note does not have it

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp2 mustContain '999 · QA Hosp Zuniga'; cp3 mustContain '999 · QA Hosp Zuniga', 'Re-assign'; cp4 Zuniga's Encounter mustContain the text; cp5 Bulk 001's Encounter mustNotContain it (U2). cp1 (no search) is recorded for Q9: whether Zuniga is listed at all

Where it ran: dev unit U05; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
